research_question: What are the authoritative, teachable principles for layout, grid, and spacing in product UI and conversion web design — covering the spacing/sizing scale (token-backed, non-arbitrary), whitespace and density, grids and alignment, proximity-based grouping, and responsive reflow — such that an AI designer agent can apply them directly in a Next/Tailwind/Radix/shadcn substrate and a vision-capable review gauntlet can mechanically PASS/FAIL a rendered layout against them?

phases.name: Landscape
phases.objective: Survey the consensus on spatial systems: why a constrained spacing scale (e.g., 4px/8px base unit, geometric-ish ramp) beats arbitrary values, how whitespace creates hierarchy and grouping, the role of grids/columns, and alignment as a grouping device.
sub_questions: How do authoritative sources (Refactoring UI 'Layout and Spacing', Material 3 layout/spacing, 8pt grid systems) define a spacing scale and justify a small fixed set of values over ad-hoc pixels?
How does the Gestalt Law of Proximity / Common Region make spacing the primary tool for visual grouping, and how does whitespace drive perceived hierarchy?
phases.evidence_priorities: Refactoring UI layout/spacing chapter; 8pt grid / 4pt grid system writeups; Material 3 spacing tokens; Laws of UX proximity/common-region; NN/g whitespace. Cite primary/authoritative sources.
phases.stop_condition: Complete when the spacing-scale rationale, the proximity-grouping principle, and the grid/alignment role are each documented from a primary source.

phases.name: Mechanics
phases.objective: Document how spatial systems are implemented and reasoned about: the base unit and ramp, spacing tokens as CSS variables / a theme scale, the proximity rule (related items closer than unrelated; space inside a group < space between groups), alignment to a grid/edges, optical vs mathematical alignment, line-length/measure interaction, and density tiers.
sub_questions: What is the concrete spacing-scale pattern (base unit, the ramp of allowed values) and how is it encoded as tokens so components consume scale steps, not magic numbers?

What are the precise, checkable rules for proximity, alignment, and consistent gaps (e.g., outer padding >= inner gaps, equal gaps between siblings, a single alignment grid) that a reviewer could verify on a rendered layout?
phases.evidence_priorities: Spacing-token implementations (CSS custom props / utility scale); 8pt-grid math; proximity/alignment rules stated checkably; measure/line-length guidance. Include concrete numeric patterns.
phases.stop_condition: Complete when the token-scale pattern, the proximity rule, and the alignment-consistency rule are each documented with a citable source and a concrete form.

phases.name: Failure Modes
phases.objective: Catalog how layout/spacing breaks and how each reads to the user and is detected: cramped/no breathing room, inconsistent/arbitrary gaps, ambiguous grouping (equal space inside and between groups), misalignment (off-grid elements), overflow/overlap, content too wide (long measure), uneven whitespace, broken responsive reflow at small viewports.
sub_questions: What are the most common, highest-impact spacing/layout defects in production UI, and how does each manifest to a user (cluttered, ungrouped, unaligned, overflowing)?

How can each defect be DETECTED from a rendered page — computed margins/paddings off the scale, unequal sibling gaps, elements not on a shared alignment edge, horizontal overflow at mobile width, line length beyond ~75ch?
phases.evidence_priorities: Common layout-mistake lists; NN/g spacing/whitespace; Refactoring UI don'ts; mobile overflow guidance. For each failure, an observed-vs-expected detection method (computed-style based).
phases.stop_condition: Complete when 6+ distinct layout/spacing failure modes are documented, each with a user-visible symptom AND a programmatic detection method.

phases.name: Contrarian
phases.objective: Surface nuance: when a strict fixed scale over-constrains (optical adjustments, content-driven layout), the limits of the 8pt grid, and density tradeoffs (information-dense pro tools vs spacious consumer UI).
sub_questions: Where does a rigid spacing scale / 8pt grid break down (optical alignment, dense data tables, fluid/clamp-based spacing), and how should a teachable rule allow disciplined exceptions without becoming arbitrary?
phases.evidence_priorities: Critiques of rigid grids; optical-alignment essays; fluid spacing (clamp) vs fixed scale; density-tradeoff discussions. Note settled vs contextual.
phases.stop_condition: Complete when 2+ substantive critiques/nuances of the strict-scale approach are documented with the recommended hedge.

search_strategy: Refactoring UI layout and spacing principles
8pt grid system spacing scale UI design
4px base unit spacing tokens design system
Gestalt law of proximity UI grouping spacing
whitespace negative space visual hierarchy NN/g
alignment grid consistency UI layout rules
optimal line length measure 45-75 characters readability
responsive reflow overflow mobile layout breakpoints
common spacing mistakes UI inconsistent padding
fluid spacing clamp vs fixed scale
exclusion_criteria: Tool/SaaS tutorials (how to use a specific design product)
CSS framework marketing without principle content
Pre-2016 articles superseded by modern responsive practice
Print-only grid theory without screen relevance

required_output_schema.per_finding_format: claim, supporting evidence, confidence (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), source URLs, counter-evidence if any

openai_instructions: Focus on concrete, checkable numeric patterns: the spacing base unit and allowed ramp (4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64...), the proximity rule formalized (intra-group gap < inter-group gap), alignment-consistency, optimal measure (~45-75 characters). Build a fault tree of layout/spacing failures, each with a programmatic detection method from computed styles (margins/paddings off-scale, unequal sibling gaps, off-grid alignment, horizontal overflow at 375px, measure > ~75ch). Deductive and precise; prefer authoritative primary sources.
gemini_instructions: SKIP — Gemini engine disabled for this run.
claude_instructions: Investigate the contrarian angle (rigid grid limits, optical alignment, fluid clamp spacing, density tradeoffs), cross-verify the 8pt-grid rationale and the optimal-measure range against primary sources, and assess how proximity (Gestalt) underpins spacing decisions. Confirm the proximity rule is stated checkably (space-inside < space-between).
